PLAN "Post-MI General Fitness (12 Weeks) Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "improve general fitness and strength safely post-MI"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "support cardiac health with nutrition"
  GOAL secondary weight_loss:
    name "support weight loss with increased cardio"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      - 3 sessions/week: 2 full-body strength + cardio, 1 cardio-only
      - Strength: squat, deadlift, leg_press, goblet_squat, bench_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, seated_row, dumbbell_row, lat_pulldown, leg_curl, calf_raise, plank, bird_dog
      - Cardio: cycling and walking, moderate intensity, HR <115 bpm, 15–22 min/session
      - RPE: 5 (easy-moderate)
      - Focus: technique, safe movement, gradual volume increase
  PHASE "Phase 2: Progression" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      - 3 sessions/week: 2 full-body strength + cardio, 1 cardio-only
      - Strength: increased sets/reps, more volume for squat, deadlift, bench_press, goblet_squat, shoulder_press, etc.
      - Cardio: cycling and walking, moderate intensity, HR <115 bpm, 25–32 min/session
      - RPE: 6 (moderate)
      - Focus: build strength endurance, increase cardio duration, maintain safety
  PHASE "Phase 3: Consolidation" (4 weeks):
    SUMMARY:
      - 3 sessions/week: 2 full-body strength + cardio, 1 cardio-only
      - Strength: peak sets/reps for squat, deadlift, bench_press, goblet_squat, shoulder_press, etc.
      - Cardio: cycling and walking, moderate intensity, HR <115 bpm, 35–42 min/session (up to 75 min on cardio-only day)
      - RPE: 6 (moderate)
      - Focus: consolidate gains, maximize safe volume, reinforce healthy habits

NUTRITION
  FOCUS "Cardiac Health":
    GUIDELINES:
      - Emphasize vegetables, fruits, whole grains, legumes, and nuts daily
      - Choose lean protein sources: fish (especially fatty fish 2x/week), skinless poultry, beans, tofu
      - Use olive oil or canola oil as primary fat; avoid trans fats and minimize saturated fat
      - Limit sodium to <2000mg/day; avoid processed and packaged foods high in salt
      - Limit added sugars; avoid sugar-sweetened beverages and desserts
      - Prefer low-fat or nonfat dairy
      - Limit red meat and processed meats
      - Alcohol: none or as advised by physician
      - Hydration: water as primary beverage, 6–8 cups/day unless otherwise directed
      - Portion control: eat slowly, stop when satisfied, avoid overeating
      - Optional: consider a Mediterranean or DASH-style eating pattern
    SAMPLE_DAY:
      BREAKFAST:
        - Oatmeal with berries and walnuts
        - Low-fat milk or fortified soy beverage
      LUNCH:
        - Grilled salmon or chickpea salad
        - Quinoa or brown rice
        - Steamed broccoli and carrots
        - Olive oil and lemon dressing
      SNACK:
        - Apple or banana
        - Handful of unsalted almonds
      DINNER:
        - Skinless chicken breast or lentil stew
        - Roasted sweet potato
        - Mixed green salad with tomatoes, cucumbers, olive oil
      SNACK:
        - Low-fat yogurt or fruit
    NOTES:
      - Consult with a registered dietitian for individualized needs and medication interactions
      - Monitor blood pressure, weight, and lipid profile regularly
      - Adjust plan as needed for comorbidities or physician recommendations
